# Frontmatter

YAML at the top of a page configures that page only. Set-level settings belong in `larecipe.json`, navigation in `navigation.json`. Unknown keys are allowed (extensions read them), but `larecipe:validate` warns about likely typos.

Every page should have `title`, `description` and `sources`. `sources` lists the code the page documents (globs from the project root, optionally `path#region`), so `php artisan larecipe:affected` can tell when the page goes stale.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | Required unless the first # heading gives it. |
| `description` | string | One sentence. Used in llms.txt, meta tags, search snippets and list_pages. |
| `order` | number | Position in zero-config navigation. |
| `icon` | string |  |
| `sources` | string or list of string | Globs of the code this page documents, for drift detection. |
| `tags` | list of string |  |
| `badge` | string or object |  |
| `since` | string or number |  |
| `deprecated` | boolean or string |  |
| `hidden` | boolean | Routable but not listed in the navigation. |
| `noindex` | boolean |  |
| `visibility` | any | private pages need the viewLarecipe gate. One of: `public`, `private`. |
| `redirect_from` | string or list of string |  |
| `layout` | any | One of: `default`, `wide`, `full`. |
| `inserts` | any or object |  |
| `type` | any | One of: `page`, `openapi`. |
| `spec` | string |  |

```yaml
---
title: Webhooks
description: Receive signed events from the app and verify them.
sources: ["app/Webhooks/**", "routes/webhooks.php"]
order: 20
---
```
